description: A stereo VCA driven by a built-in fade-in and fade-out envelope, for topping and tailing a recording

params.text: Click once to begin the fade-in and again to begin the fade-out
Sets how long the fade-in takes, 0.1 to 10 seconds
Sets how long the fade-out takes, 0.1 to 10 seconds
Passes the inputs through at full level so recording levels can be set, sending no start, stop or run signals; it cannot be on while the fade is running

inputs.text: The left or mono signal to be faded; a polyphonic cable is passed through channel for channel
The right signal to be faded; a polyphonic cable is passed through channel for channel
Starts and stops the fade from an outside signal instead of the START/STOP button; monophonic

outputs.text: The left or mono input at the level set by the fade envelope
The right input at the level set by the fade envelope
10V from the start of the fade-in until the end of the fade-out, and 0V otherwise
A 1ms 10V trigger at the start of the fade-in and another at the end of the fade-out

notes: nothing reaches the outputs until the fade-in is started from the START/STOP button or the CTRL input; MONITOR passes the inputs through at full level so that levels can be set first
the display counts up in hours, minutes and seconds from the moment the fade-in begins
once started, the fade-in and fade-out always run to the end, however briefly the stop is asked for
menu: Control Input Mode — reads the CTRL input as a Gate, fading in on its rising edge and out on its falling edge, or as Start/Stop triggers that alternate
Add output expander — places a Fade-in/Fade-out Expander to the right of this module

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
